directionContract.thesis: Bob Swayne Real Estate should feel immediate, composed, and unmistakably itself on a phone.
directionContract.ownWorld: image first editorial system in deep navy, vivid orange, warm paper, cyan glints, and visibly tactile film grain.
directionContract.story: Move from orientation to legal question, source context, disclosed visual direction, and a direct official action.
directionContract.firstViewport: Source-verifiable identity, one clear proposition, one Align editorial image, and one thumb-ready action.
directionContract.form: Mobile-first legal practice homepage with an ink-resolved identity finale.

hero.headline: Clarity for the question in front of you.
hero.sub: Bob Swayne Real Estate deserves a first screen that makes the next step legible without flattening the character of the work. This private concept begins with the official identity and first-party source material.

offerings.heading: A homepage organized around the decision a visitor is actually making.
items: Understand the role of Bob Swayne Real Estate without searching through the page
See a clearly disclosed, business-relevant visual direction before choosing the next legal question
Reach the official source through one direct, clearly labelled action

story.heading: Identity and evidence lead. The interface follows.
paragraphs: Find homes for sale, find an agent, view virtual tours, receive homes by e-mail, learn about buying and selling a home and more!

This concept uses generated editorial imagery as illustrative direction, not as evidence about the business. The composition gives each image room to establish scale and character while the written hierarchy stays concise enough for a phone.
No testimonial, result, price, award, schedule, or service promise is added here. Current operational details remain under the control of the official website.

experience.heading: A deliberate path from first impression to official action.
items: Readable source-led narrative with decisive image rhythm
A consistent action that stays reachable without interrupting the page

gallery.heading: Illustrative concept imagery, cut into a tactile mobile editorial rhythm.

feature.heading: The page disappears behind the work, then returns to the identity.
feature.text: As each section passes, progressive motion lets completed information soften without turning the page into a scroll experiment. The final scene returns to the verified Bob Swayne Real Estate logo with its geometry preserved.

catalog.heading: Three useful routes, kept honest and direct.

items.title: Review current services and project information
Confirm current location and contact details
Decide whether the next legal question makes sense

contact.heading: Current details belong to the official source.
contact.sub: This private concept sends nothing. Generated imagery does not depict Bob Swayne Real Estate, its staff, customers, facility, products, projects, or outcomes. Use the official website to confirm services, availability, hours, and contact details.

closing.heading: A stronger first impression, resolved to the verified logo.
